name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: REST APIs that let Amazon selling partners automate orders, shipments, pricing, listings, inventory and reports.
auth_notes: Public apps: OAuth 2.0 via Login with Amazon (LWA), seller authorizes, reauthorization annually. Private apps: self-authorize in Seller Central/Vendor Central/Solution Provider Portal. Restricted data needs a Restricted Data Token.
access_notes: Register in Solution Provider Portal (identity verification, business docs). Public developers need a complete security review and appear in the Selling Partner Appstore; private developers get streamlined review. Restricted (PII) roles need enhanced security documentation. No fee found on fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Broad documented REST API, sandbox, notifications and rate limits, but production needs developer registration with identity verification, role approval and (public apps) security review.

needs_human_reason: Endpoint count and breadth rely on a third-party claim (300+ endpoints); MCP is a local sample-repo server from Amazon's amzn GitHub org, not a hosted product; role approval timing unknown.

auth.quote: Private applications are for exclusive use by a single organization.

access.quote: Restricted roles: Provide access to personally identifiable information (PII) and require enhanced security.
Your applications appear in the Selling Partner Appstore and require a complete security review.

sandbox.quote: provides two hosted and one local sandbox environment that you can use to test your applications

api_surface.quote: The SP-API uses the token bucket algorithm to rate-limit requests to the API.
Instead of polling for information, your application can receive information directly from Amazon when an event generates a notification
over 300 endpoints across Orders, Catalog, Finances, Inventory, Reports, Notifications, Vendor Central, and more

mcp.quote: A local MCP server that bundles SP-API developer tools into a single npm package

disputes.why: Amazon's amzn GitHub org publishes sp-api-dev-mcp (local MCP) in samples repo; jay-trivedi repo is a separate community project.
Notifications API pushes events to destinations (EventBridge/SQS) instead of polling.
Many API families; third-party guide cites 300+ endpoints (not primary-verified).
Docs list generated Java/C# SDKs and prebuilt SDK tutorials for five languages.
Public apps require a complete security review before Appstore listing.
